script.base: Market prices LAC to lead (implied 28.0 to ARI 19.5) in a dome with a mid total, so the base flow is LAC ahead by halftime and closing with Omarion Hampton carries while ARI, as an 8.5-point dog with G Isaiah Adams out, cannot stay on the ground and throws toward Michael Wilson and Trey McBride.
script.flip1: LAC gets up by two scores early, Hampton's carries rise until a possible late bench (8.5 is a mild blowout, not a lock), ARI abandons Bam Knight/Tyler Allgeier rushes, and LAC WR yards (Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston) stall if the lead is safe while ARI dropbacks rise but three-and-outs can cap yards.
script.flip2: ARI hangs within a score, or Tuli Tuipulotu (hip, questionable) sits and the ARI pass game has time: both passing games stay live for four quarters and Hampton never gets the clock-kill script. The other break is Adams-out pressure collapsing ARI into checkdowns (McBride/RB catches) so Wilson's downfield yards die even though attempts do not.
